public static Optional<VersionFlag> detectVersionFromPath(Path path) {
    return StreamSupport.stream(path.spliterator(), false)
        .map(Path::toString)
        .map(supportedVersions::get)
        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
        .findAny();
}

- ClassCastException? Not.
